policy: Qualify wallet applications only for the exact Genesis user journey: establish a wallet identity, make a qualifying USDT payment on a supported rail, and receive ACROWN as an SPL token on Solana. Wallet-specific dApp signing on every payment chain and wallet recovery testing on every chain are not requirements.

outsideCurrentWave.note: Kept outside this five-wallet test wave based on the previously identified TRON dApp route limitation. That limitation is not a general disqualification under the narrowed workflow because TRON payment attribution is performed from on-chain evidence, not a TRON wallet dApp signature.

minimum: Connect one supported primary wallet address
Prove control of that address with a domain-bound off-chain message signature on one supported identity route
Verify the signature server-side against the exact address, network, nonce, purpose, domain and expiry
identity.tronIdentity: Optional where the selected wallet has a compatible TRON message-signing provider. TRON signing is not mandatory when the primary identity is established through Ethereum or Solana.

minimum: The participant can initiate a USDT transfer from the wallet application on at least one accepted rail
Genesis binds the payment to a server-created payment intent or equivalent approved attribution record
Genesis independently verifies the actual on-chain sender, canonical USDT asset, treasury, exact amount, transaction success, finality and uniqueness
payment.attribution: Target design: the wallet does not notify Genesis that payment happened. A submitted transaction hash or chain watcher starts discovery; the chain verifier is authoritative. The verified transaction records the actual sending address against a server-created payment intent. Current implementation boundary: the read-only parsers and two-source reconciliation exist, but the payment-intent API and one-time on-chain source-address proof/write path do not yet exist. The current payment schema still requires a pre-verified PAYMENT wallet-address row.
walletProviderNotRequired: A dApp provider on every accepted payment network
A TRON signMessageV2 method solely to attribute a completed TRON payment
A wallet callback or browser event announcing payment completion
payment.networkSelection: A wallet is not required to provide dApp integration or USDT transfer capability on all three rails. It may qualify for the rails it can actually use; the Genesis payment service must independently support and qualify each rail it offers.

minimum: Provide a valid Solana recipient address
Prove control of a separate Solana delivery address by an off-chain Solana message signature or a separately approved equivalent
Confirm that the wallet can receive the ACROWN SPL token
delivery.transferActor: AstroCrown's separately authorized Solana treasury/distribution signer submits the ACROWN transfer. The participant wallet is the recipient and does not need to sign or send the ACROWN transfer.
walletProviderNotRequired: Participant-side Solana transaction signing for token receipt
Participant-side SOL gas payment for an AstroCrown-signed delivery

notRequiredForWalletQualification: Signing an identity challenge independently on all three payment networks
Connecting to a dApp on every payment network
Sending and receiving USDT on all three networks in every wallet application
Wallet-vendor recovery/restore testing across all three networks
The participant wallet signing or sending the ACROWN delivery transaction

serverVerification: exact Transfer event sender and treasury
exact Transfer event sender and treasury
canonical USDT mint and Token Program
exact source and treasury token-account owners

systemWideGates: Implement a server-created payment intent and safe one-time on-chain proof path for a source address that is not already linked by an off-chain wallet signature; until then only the primary or a previously verified linked payment address can be credited.
Each enabled payment rail passes its own independent chain-evidence and finality tests
Two independently operated RPC providers agree on the same normalized transfer evidence before payment credit
A server-created payment intent binds identity, payment purpose, selected network, exact asset, treasury and amount
Network plus transaction ID plus transfer or instruction index is unique and duplicate observations are idempotent
A verified payment creates only the separately defined purchase entitlement; it does not itself issue ACROWN
ACROWN purchase uses a contemporaneous approved ACS pure-floor quote and consumes entitlement atomically
The Solana ACROWN destination is verified and the outgoing token transfer is independently reconciled
All financial events are append-only and corrections are compensating events

productionAcceptance.reason: The payment-intent and one-time on-chain payment-source binding/write path are not implemented. Live identity signatures, selected payment-route confirmation, verified Solana recipient and SPL receipt tests on installed wallet builds also remain incomplete. The narrowed policy does not require each wallet to sign on all three payment chains or undergo three-chain restore testing.
